items.title: A fix release
items.text: No new features, 60 fixes and polish items found in a full security and bug sweep.

items.title: Linking
items.text: A linked server can no longer make itself the services server, take our services bot off the network with KILL, uncloak our users with MODE -x, or give users a host or ident with @, !, * or spaces.

items.title: Linking
items.text: On the server that runs services, a linked server can no longer log its users in to someone's account (in its burst, with SVSLOGIN, METADATA accountname or svid); they stay logged out and opers get one notice. Real logins through SASL or NickServ on other servers keep working, also after a netsplit, a restart and the upgrade from an older version.

items.title: Linking
items.text: Users on other servers logged in through services stay logged in when the services server restarts cold, not only after a seamless update.

items.title: Linking
items.text: A user on a linked server with one of our services nicks no longer drops the whole link, and a link to a network with its own services no longer retries every few seconds and floods opers with notices.
